_doc: Story cards: location stories, encounter cards, and agenda scenes. `kind` sets the frame colour. A choice runs `effects`, or makes a `test` and runs `success` or `fail`. A choice with `if` shows only when its condition holds.

THE_GARDENS.title: The Gardens
text: The fungus leans toward you as you pass. Spores drift up like snow falling the wrong way.
Deep in the growth, something glints: a Hunter's tag, still on its chain.

success.text: The tag reads KESTREL. Lantern goes quiet for a moment.

fail.text: The growth closes on your arm. You pull free, but your hands won't stop shaking.

ECHO_LOG.title: Lantern's Decode
text: LANTERN: Got something. It's a pattern in the loops. She doesn't sleep, Rook. She listens.
LANTERN: Everything you hear in here, she heard first.

BURN_THE_EGGS.title: Burn the Eggs
text: You could burn this nursery. It would take time, and the heat would carry through the hive.
Every egg here is a death on the planet below.

effects.text: The eggs pop like fat in a pan. Somewhere deep, something screams.

CORONATION.title: Coronation
text: The hull shudders. The singing stops all at once.

SKITTERING.title: Skittering
text: Claws on the ceiling. Two shapes drop from the dark.

SPITTER_NEST.title: Spitter Nest
text: A wet hiss, and the wall beside you smokes.

SLUG_TIDE.title: Slug Tide
text: The floor is moving. The floor is many small things moving.

SPORE_BLOOM.title: Spore Bloom
text: A fungal pod bursts at head height. The air turns gold.

success.text: You keep it out of your lungs.

fail.text: You breathe it in. Your next fight starts with 2 Spores in your deck.

SCAN_SWEEP.title: Scan Sweep
text: A wave of pressure washes through the corridor. The hive is looking for you.

fail.text: It found you. You lose 1 energy on the first turn of your next fight.

ALERT_PULSE.title: Alert Pulse
text: Every wall throbs at once. Something is waking up faster.

CLEAR_SIGNAL.title: Clear Signal
text: LANTERN: Rook! For a second there, I could see the whole level. Sending you what I've got.

COVER_POSITION.title: Cover Position
text: A collapsed rib of the hull makes a good wall. You take a breath behind it.

effects.text: Your next fight starts with 8 Shields.

WHISPERS.title: Whispers
text: Your name, said in a voice you have not heard in years.

SOMETHING_FOLLOWS.title: Something Follows
text: Behind you, far back, the sound of something matching your steps.
